# Systems Thinking

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

Lecture notes for a course on Systems Thinking,
hosted at <https://d-morrison.github.io/systems/>.

## Building the website

### Local preview

To preview the website with live reload during development:

```bash
quarto preview
```

This will open your website in a web browser and automatically refresh when you make changes.

### Render the website

To render the complete website:

```bash
quarto render
```

The output will be generated in the `_site/` directory.

### Multiple output formats

This website supports multiple output formats in a single render:

- **Website pages** (`.html`)
- **RevealJS slides** (`-slides.html`)
- **PDF handouts** (`-handout.pdf`)
- **DOCX documents** (`.docx`)

## Publishing to GitHub Pages

This repository includes a GitHub Actions workflow (`.github/workflows/publish.yml`) that automatically builds and publishes the website to GitHub Pages when you push to the main branch.

### Setup steps:

1. **Enable GitHub Pages** in your repository:
   - Go to Settings → Pages
   - Under "Build and deployment", set Source to "GitHub Actions"

2. **Push to main branch**:
   ```bash
   git add .
   git commit -m "Initial website setup"
   git push origin main
   ```

3. **Wait for the workflow** to complete (check the Actions tab)

4. **Access your website** at: `https://d-morrison.github.io/systems/`

## GitHub Actions Workflows

This repository includes several automated workflows:

### 🚀 Publish Workflow (`publish.yml`)

Automatically builds and deploys the website to GitHub Pages when you push to the main branch.

### 🔍 PR Preview Workflow (`preview.yml`)

Creates a preview deployment for pull requests with change detection and highlighting.

### ✅ Spell Check Workflow (`check-spelling.yaml`)

Runs automated spell checking on pushes and pull requests.

### 📋 Lint Project Workflow (`lint-project.yaml`)

Checks R code style and quality using the lintr package.

### 📚 Check Bibliography DOIs Workflow (`check-bibliography-dois.yml`)

Validates that all books and articles in bibliography files have DOI fields that resolve correctly.

## Project Structure

```
.
├── _quarto.yml              # Main configuration file
├── _quarto-website.yml      # Website-specific configuration
├── index.qmd                # Website homepage
├── chapters/                # Chapter files
│   └── meadows-2001.qmd     # Meadows (2001): Dancing with Systems
├── references.qmd           # References page
├── references.bib           # BibTeX bibliography
├── styles.css               # Custom CSS styles
├── lychee.toml              # Link checker configuration
├── .gitignore               # Git ignore file
├── LICENSE                  # License
├── README.md                # This file
├── macros/                  # Git submodule: d-morrison/macros
└── .github/
    ├── scripts/             # Scripts for workflows
    └── workflows/           # GitHub Actions workflows
```
